name: astro
title: Astro
description: Astro app scaffolded by create-astro, wired into the mx stack with Postgres, Redis, Traefik routing and dev/prod Docker builds
features: App scaffolded by `create-astro` itself — the framework owns package.json and the app tree
Dependency-free /api/health endpoint (works on a fresh scaffold)
PostgreSQL + Redis siblings, wired via DATABASE_URL / REDIS_URL
Dev/Prod Docker builds (hot-reload dev stage, static-or-SSR production stage)

init_cmd.description: Command to scaffold the Astro app (runs from ./apps; must be non-interactive and must create {{SERVICE_NAME}}/)

force_init.description: Re-run init_cmd by deleting apps/{{SERVICE_NAME}} first (DANGEROUS). Set with `mx add <name> --recipe astro --opt force_init=true`

notes: `create-astro` owns the app: package.json, tsconfig.json, astro.config.mjs and the starter pages are the scaffolder's, not this recipe's (bd:mech-crate-874)
This recipe installs infra (compose, Dockerfiles, env) plus one app file: a dependency-free src/pages/api/health.ts

Output mode is the app's call. The default scaffold has no adapter, so `astro build` emits a static dist/ and the production stage serves it with the scaffold's own `preview` script; run `astro add node` in the app and the same stage execs dist/server/entry.mjs instead (bd:mech-crate-47j)
API routes under src/pages/api/; add `export const prerender = false` only once an adapter is configured
Environment variables: PUBLIC_ prefix for client-side access
Server-only vars (DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET) are not exposed to client
Re-scaffold an app from scratch with `mx add <name> --recipe astro --opt force_init=true` (deletes apps/<name> first)
